```artifact
Finite State Machine for Alarm Management:

States:
- Idle
- LowPressureAlarmActive
- LowPressureAlarmInactive
- HighPressureAlarmActive
- HighPressureAlarmInactive
- PIPTooHighAlarmActive
- PIPTooHighAlarmInactive

Events:
- PressureBelowThreshold (inspiratory pressure < low pressure threshold)
- PressureAboveThreshold (inspiratory pressure > high pressure threshold)
- BreathAboveThreshold (inspiratory pressure > high pressure threshold for consecutive breaths)
- BreathBelowThreshold (inspiratory pressure < low pressure threshold)
- CancelAlarm
- ToggleSound

Transitions and Guards:
1. Idle → LowPressureAlarmActive on PressureBelowThreshold
2. LowPressureAlarmActive → LowPressureAlarmInactive on BreathAboveThreshold (pressure > low pressure threshold)
3. Idle → HighPressureAlarmActive on BreathAboveThreshold (3+ consecutive breaths)
4. HighPressureAlarmActive → HighPressureAlarmInactive on BreathBelowThreshold
5. Idle → PIPTooHighAlarmActive on PressureAboveThreshold (PIP > default PIP + 5 cm H2O)
6. PIPTooHighAlarmActive → PIPTooHighAlarmInactive on BreathBelowThreshold (PIP < default PIP + 5 cm H2O)
7. LowPressureAlarmActive / PIPTooHighAlarmActive → (state unchanged) on CancelAlarm
8. AnyState → (state unchanged) on ToggleSound (enables/disables sound for active alarms)

Logging:
- LowPressureAlarmActive: log "Low pressure alarm ON"
- LowPressureAlarmInactive: log "Low pressure alarm OFF"
- HighPressureAlarmActive: log "High pressure alarm ON"
- HighPressureAlarmInactive: log "High pressure alarm OFF"
- PIPTooHighAlarmActive: log "PIP too high alarm ON"
- AlarmActive with sound disabled: log "Alarm visible, no sound"

Priority:
- LowPressureAlarmActive and PIPTooHighAlarmActive have high priority.
```

    "title": "Trigger and reset low pressure alarm",

    "inputs": {
      "name": "PressureBelowThreshold",

    },
    "steps": [
      "Send PressureBelowThreshold event",

      "Send BreathAboveThreshold event (pressure > low pressure threshold)",

      "Verify log message 'Low pressure alarm OFF'"
    ],
    "expected": [
      "Transition to LowPressureAlarmActive",
      "Log 'Low pressure alarm ON'",
      "Transition to LowPressureAlarmInactive",
      "Log 'Low pressure alarm OFF'"
    ]
  },

    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "High priority low pressure alarm",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-86", "RW-SW-93"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["System in Idle state"],
    "inputs": {
      "name": "PressureBelowThreshold",
      "value": "inspiratory pressure < low pressure threshold"
    },
    "steps": [
      "Send PressureBelowThreshold event",
      "Verify transition Idle → LowPressureAlarmActive",
      "Verify log message 'Low pressure alarm ON'",
      "Verify alarm priority is high"
    ],
    "expected": [
      "Transition to LowPressureAlarmActive",
      "Log 'Low pressure alarm ON'",
      "Alarm priority is high"
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Trigger and cancel high pressure alarm",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-88", "RW-SW-89", "RW-SW-90"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["System in Idle state"],
    "inputs": {
      "name": "BreathAboveThreshold",
      "value": "inspiratory pressure > high pressure threshold for 3+ consecutive breaths"
    },
    "steps": [
      "Send BreathAboveThreshold event",
      "Verify transition Idle → HighPressureAlarmActive",
      "Verify log message 'High pressure alarm ON'",
      "Verify sound is emitted",
      "Send CancelAlarm event",
      "Verify transition HighPressureAlarmActive → HighPressureAlarmInactive",
      "Verify log message 'High pressure alarm OFF'",
      "Verify alarm remains displayed until CancelAlarm is issued"
    ],
    "expected": [
      "Transition to HighPressureAlarmActive",
      "Log 'High pressure alarm ON'",
      "Sound is emitted",
      "Transition to HighPressureAlarmInactive",
      "Log 'High pressure alarm OFF'",
      "Alarm remains displayed until CancelAlarm"
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "High priority PIP too high alarm",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-94", "RW-SW-93"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["System in Idle state"],
    "inputs": {
      "name": "PressureAboveThreshold",
      "value": "inspiratory pressure > default PIP value + 5 cm H2O"
    },
    "steps": [
      "Send PressureAboveThreshold event",
      "Verify transition Idle → PIPTooHighAlarmActive",
      "Verify log message 'PIP too high alarm ON'",
      "Verify alarm priority is high"
    ],
    "expected": [
      "Transition to PIPTooHighAlarmActive",
      "Log 'PIP too high alarm ON'",
      "Alarm priority is high"
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Alarm visibility toggle with sound enabled",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-91"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["System in PIPTooHighAlarmActive state"],
    "inputs": {
      "name": "ToggleSound",
      "value": "enable sound"
    },
    "steps": [
      "Send ToggleSound event",
      "Verify alarm sound is enabled",
      "Verify log message 'Alarm visible, no sound' is not emitted"
    ],
    "expected": [
      "Sound is enabled",
      "No log message 'Alarm visible, no sound'"
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-006",
    "title": "Negative path: low pressure alarm reset failure",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-86"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["System in LowPressureAlarmActive state"],
    "inputs": {
      "name": "BreathBelowThreshold",
      "value": "inspiratory pressure < low pressure threshold"
    },
    "steps": [
      "Send BreathBelowThreshold event",
      "Verify transition LowPressureAlarmActive → LowPressureAlarmInactive is NOT triggered"
    ],
    "expected": [
      "No transition to LowPressureAlarmInactive"
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-007",
    "title": "Boundary value: high pressure alarm inactivity",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-88"],
    "kind": "boundary",
    "preconditions": ["System in HighPressureAlarmActive state"],
    "inputs": {
      "name": "BreathBelowThreshold",
      "value": "inspiratory pressure < high pressure threshold"
    },
    "steps": [
      "Send BreathBelowThreshold event",
      "Verify transition HighPressureAlarmActive → HighPressureAlarmInactive",
      "Verify alarm remains displayed until CancelAlarm"
    ],
    "expected": [
      "Transition to HighPressureAlarmInactive",
      "Alarm remains displayed until CancelAlarm"
    ]
  }
]
